title: Mai Wasa Da Zinare A Cikin Daji
intro: Ka yi tunanin wani babban sansanin hamada a cikin ɗan lokaci na jira da rashin tabbas. Wani babban shugaba ya tafi don ganawa da Allah, ya bar al'umma da ke sha'awar wani abu mai ma'ana da za ta riƙe. A cikin wannan ɗan gajeren lokaci, wani mutum mai lallashi ya taka gaba tare da alkawura masu haske da kuma wani halitta mai wayo wanda ya yi kama da mai rai.
clues: Ina cikin waɗanda suka bar Masar tare da Musa, ina ganin yadda teku ta rabu don gudunmu.
Na kalli lokacin da shugabanmu ya tafi dutsen na tsawon dare arba'in don samun jagora.
Na tattara kayan ado daga mutanen kuma na siffanta su da hannuna.
Na yi wa ɗan maraƙi wani irin ƙara mai ƙarfi, na kuma kira mutane zuwa gare shi.
Na ɗauki ƙura kaɗan daga cikin hanyar manzon na jefa ta cikin abin da na yi.
Musa ya fuskance ni, aka kuma yanke min hukunci na ce 'kada ka taɓa ni' in zauna a ware, tare da alƙawarin yin taro don yanke hukunci.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
